name: claude-plusplus
description: Unofficial tweak platform for Claude Code Desktop on Windows

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @claude-plusplus/sdk && npm run build --workspace @claude-plusplus/runtime && npm run build --workspace @claude-plusplus/installer && npm run build --workspace @claude-plusplus/loader
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.mjs packages/*/test/*.test.*
